# Esteban Baez Coaching Dojo

> Esteban Baez is an AI sales trainer and business consultant for business owners going from $10K to $50K a month. He teaches owners and sales teams to close with a repeatable call structure, run sales and operations with Claude Code, regulate their nervous system under pressure, and grow the business with a quarterly goals and weekly meeting rhythm ("Dominating Quarters").

## What he coaches
- AI for sales and operations: call notes, follow-up drafts, pipeline checks and reports with Claude Code, with a human approving anything sent
- Sales: the DRIA call framework (Desire, Reality, Impact, Ask), objection handling, call reviews
- Nervous system regulation: physical and mental wellness for people who sell and lead under pressure
- Dominating Quarters: 3 to 5 quarterly goals, a weekly scorecard and a weekly leadership meeting, run in Strety

## Who it's for
- Owners and operators doing about $10K a month on hustle, ready to grow to $50K a month
- Teams that have never set quarterly goals, tracked a weekly scorecard or held a weekly leadership meeting

- Owners who want to work in a state of thriving: creativity, expansion and growth

## Who it's not for
- Businesses already at $50K+ a month
- People who love the hustle and don't want a coach
- Pioneers who prefer trial and error over modeling a proven system
- People who like living in survival mode: fear, anxiety and stress

## Track record
- 3,100+ sales calls booked since 2022
- 850+ deals personally closed
- 41% close rate on qualified calls (measured April to October 2026)
